name: sing-box dashboard bar widget
author: cheebun
description: A native Omarchy status bar widget and full-featured control panel for sing-box (specifically optimized for sing-box 1.14+ via its daemon gRPC API). Built following the official sing-box dashboard design language and Omarchy shell plugin standards.

barWidget.description: sing-box proxy controller, traffic monitor, and node selector

schema.label: API URL
schema.description: sing-box daemon gRPC API (services type "api"), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9999

schema.label: Display traffic in bar
schema.description: Show real-time upload and download speeds in the bar widget
